info.description: Embed YouTube or other video content in articles

title.description: Title of the video (for accessibility and reference)

youtube_id.description: YouTube video ID (optional, will be extracted from URL if not provided)

description.description: Short description of the video content

caption.description: Short caption to display below the video

start_time.description: Start time in seconds (optional, to begin video at specific timestamp)

autoplay.description: Whether the video should autoplay (not recommended for accessibility)

muted.description: Whether the video should start muted

width.description: Video player width in pixels (optional, defaults to responsive container)

height.description: Video player height in pixels (optional, defaults to responsive container)
